text.en: Owners who have been coming for years praise the groomer's reliability — she is always on time and never cancels. She is described as patient, attentive, and easy to talk to, consistently making both dogs and their owners feel at ease from the first visit.

Reviewers report their dogs always leave looking and smelling fantastic. One owner with a cocker spaniel has returned for ten years and notes the quality remains consistently high. The wash and cut is described as perfect, with dogs coming away impeccably presented.

Several owners bring dogs that struggle with people or grooming and specifically chose this groomer as a result. Their dogs are described as feeling safe and happy, and one owner notes their dog loves visiting despite being generally anxious. The patient, gentle approach is what keeps long-term clients returning.

q.en: Is this groomer good with nervous or difficult dogs?

a.en: Multiple reviewers specifically mention bringing dogs that are anxious around people or reluctant to be groomed, and report that their dogs were happy and relaxed throughout.
Contact details are listed on the Google Maps card for The Dog Groomer in Rodley. Several reviewers note appointments are readily available.
One reviewer notes that parking can be tricky at this location.
